profile.headline: Senior Specialist Web Developer at Save the Children US
profile.summary:
➦ Senior Web Developer and Front-End Engineer, credited with 12-years of progressive experiences developing and enhancing components and applications using functional and detail design requirements, landing page development designs, and providing efficient front-end systems

➦ Serve as a technical subject matter expert and web production technical resource

➦ Provide business and project expertise through collaboration with designers, editors, and developers, clients, IT resources, vendors, consultants, and other stakeholders to identify user requirements, assess technologies, along with recommendations and implementation of technical solutions

➦ Skillful applying problem-solving skills to investigate and research complex systems to establish root cause and resolution

➦ Technical proficiency includes Adobe Experience Manager, AJAX, Apache, BBIS, Blackbaud Sphere, ColdFusion, CSS, Drupal, Fireworks, Fusebox, Git, Google Analytics, HTML, Java, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, Maven, Microsoft Office Suite, Photoshop, PHP, SQL, SVN, WordPress, XML

Core Competencies 

➦ Managing Online Material 
➦ Webpage Creation
➦ Design Specifications 
➦ Logical Structure 	
➦ Information Architecture
➦ Client Services 
➦ Technology Implementation  
➦ Solution Management 	
➦ Workflow Management 
➦ Technical Procedures 
➦ Process Improvements 
➦ Quality & Useability

positions.title: Senior Specialist Web Developer
positions.description:
➦ Serve as technical contact, and Web Production technical resource to Adobe managed services and UK colleagues sharing environment

➦ Facilitate coding accuracy to create technical documentation, utilize software configuration, version, and quality management processes

➦ Directly manage content management system including service packs, hotfixes, software version upgrades, QA environment full responsibility, Pre-Prod and Prod Environment Scheduling, Code Updates, and Code QA

➦ Engage in collaborative communications with Managed Services and UK colleagues sharing environment regarding system upgrade

➦ Convert single-page applications and landing pages developed by external vendors into components and templates to work with AEM and support marketing efforts 

➦ Create User Groups with differing privileges for different working groups within CMS

➦ Ability to provide component and template creation (front and backend) with and without mockups

positions.title: Specialist, Digital Development
positions.description:
➦ Facilitated system upgrade from AEM 6.3 to 6.5 by completing all coding and QA work; oversaw external  communications with Adobe Managed Services and UK colleagues, which shared the environment and impacted teams internally

➦ Assisted with Content Management System migration from Blackbaud Sphere to Adobe Experience Manager

➦ Supported content authors in creating pages AEM by creating components and templates from provided User Stories

➦ Created tools to pull content from Sphere and converted content to stand-alone backups/content, imported to AEM, and reduced manual workload

➦ Set-up Redirects and Vanity URLs redirects from old URLs to new URLs, which retained link equity for SEO, and assisted with marketing efforts

➦ Provided Dispatcher and Apache configuration customization to ensure site visitors utilize secure connections and place standard security practices

➦ Set-up Global Redirects for international marketing campaign donation forms sent to individuals outside the U.S. to Save the Children International Member country donation forms

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer
positions.description:
➦ Successfully converted desktop-only designs for landing pages, which support tablet, mobile devices, and strengthened marketing efforts

➦ Created JSON endpoints to provide availability to server-level information to shared hosting systems; provided aggregated petition signing information from multiple systems

➦ Led technical implementation of site redesign by taking mockups and designs and translating to new templates and style sheets

➦ Played integral role participating in meetings to flag technical limitations or address concerns

➦ Modified markup and style sheets to support responsive design through templates designed for desktop only users

➦ Provided maintenance, optimization, and improvement of internal JavaScript framework

➦ Expertise included WordPress microsite setup; landing page development from designs; Google Analytics code implementations and Google Tag Manager implementations
